Summary: 10 requirements reviewed: 3 with issues, 7 without. 3 issues found (1 High, 1 Medium, 1 Low). Types: Vague_Language (1), Incomplete_Requirement (1), Internal_Contradiction (1).

RequirementReviews.RequirementStatement: REQ-001: The system shall send an order confirmation email to the customer within 60 seconds of a successful payment.
REQ-002: The system shall apply free shipping to all orders with a subtotal of $50 or more.
REQ-003: The checkout page shall load quickly and support a large number of shoppers.
REQ-004: Managers and finance staff who have completed security training shall be able to approve refunds.
REQ-005: Payment transaction records shall be retained for audit purposes.
REQ-006: Customers shall be able to cancel an order at any time before it is dispatched.
REQ-007: Customers shall not be able to cancel an order once payment has been confirmed.
REQ-008: The order service shall never reject a valid order.
REQ-009: The product search shall return results within 1.5 seconds for 98% of searches under 2,000 concurrent shoppers.
REQ-010: Customer payment card numbers shall be stored in encrypted form.

IssuesIdentified.Evidence: The checkout page shall load quickly and support a large number of shoppers.
IssuesIdentified.Explanation: The terms 'quickly' and 'large number' have no objective interpretation, so the performance requirement cannot be verified.
IssuesIdentified.Recommendation: Replace 'quickly' with a specific load time metric and 'large number' with a defined shopper count threshold.

IssuesIdentified.Evidence: Payment transaction records shall be retained for audit purposes.
IssuesIdentified.Explanation: The requirement lacks a retention duration, so the audit retention period cannot be implemented or verified.
IssuesIdentified.Recommendation: Specify the duration for which payment transaction records must be retained for audit purposes.

IssuesIdentified.Evidence: Customers shall be able to cancel an order at any time before it is dispatched.
IssuesIdentified.Explanation: REQ-006 states cancellation is allowed before dispatch, but REQ-007 states cancellation is not allowed once payment is confirmed, which conflicts with dispatch timing.
IssuesIdentified.Recommendation: Clarify the dispatch timing definition to resolve the conflict between cancellation eligibility and payment confirmation.
